adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new behavior that depends on correct server serialization and client hydration: Admin::EmbeddingController renders EmbeddingSerializer with `has_many :embeddable_hosts, ... embed: :ids` (app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb) and the JS store was changed to hydrate `*_ids` arrays into pluralized relationships (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6). However, spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb only asserts the controller subclasses AdminController and never hits `#show`/`#update` or validates the JSON shape (e.g., presence of `embeddable_host_ids` plus side-loaded `embeddable_hosts`). So a broken EmbeddingSerializer/REST payload could pass CI. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than an immediately verifiable runtime bug.
